media_gate: three ready assets per campaign in v3 media registry before manifest; planner chunks 1-100 campaigns into bundles of two
ad_naming_gate: every asset_ref requires canonical_filename; ad=AD NN - canonical stem; creative=CPV CNN ADNN canonical stem; asset_id is forbidden as display name
first_delivery_postprocess: after validated hierarchy readback, every production campaign is auto-allowlisted and armed in the 15-minute watcher; first spend observed 00:30-02:00 SP releases without pause, later first spend pauses once and queues next-day 00:30 reactivation
first_delivery_fail_closed: campaign completion remains POSTPROCESS_PENDING until watcher enrollment returns exact campaign IDs, armed count and meta_writes=0
write_gate: config.enabled=true and config.write_enabled=true plus --confirm-execute from an authorized campaign request
first_production_request: guarded canary automatically: prevalidated manifest, first bundle monitored, fail closed on any drift

authorization.scope: build, install and activate v3 as the production route under development_access guards; no campaign object requested by this activation
